summary: Context-only shadow deliberation: the measured tape remains risk-on (75) with normalizing volatility, healthy credit, and broad 200-day participation, but the confirmed US Q2 Reflation label is internally unsupported by current axes (growth -0.47, inflation +0.52): raw Q3 has persisted 4 of the required 7 sessions. Liquidity is contracting in an orderly, non-stressed drain, while real yields are restrictive and near a five-year extreme. The risk radar is WATCH, but its measured 21-session >=5% pullback rate is 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate (0.73x), so it is an early context flag, not an edge. Factor evidence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G records, no surviving scorecard legs, and the named low-beta leader has negative IC. The spine/kernel do not justify origination: no reviewed engine is armed; radar has negative signed excess across horizons, alt-data loses out of sample, and several desk families show negative 63-day signed excess. No hypothesis was staked because the available patterns were either already represented by current contradictions or lacked sufficient mature, independent evidence for a useful pre-committed test.
